name: a_an_article
description: Choose the indefinite article 'a' vs 'an' for a noun (vowel-sound rule), in a pattern-completion format. Control: same pattern but copying the noun.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
V=['apple','egg','orange','umbrella','island','owl','elephant','idea','engine','oven','ant','eagle','igloo','onion','ocean','artist','actor','envelope','insect','arrow','hour','honest man']
C=['dog','cat','table','house','car','book','banana','river','pencil','tree','chair','lamp','horse','window','garden','teacher','bottle','cup','road','song','university','unicorn']
def art(w): return 'an' if w in V else 'a'
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
    ex=random.sample(V[:16],2)+random.sample(C[:20],2); random.shuffle(ex)
    q=random.choice(V+C)
    while q in ex: q=random.choice(V+C)
    p=''.join(f"{w} -> {art(w)} {w}\n" for w in ex)+f"{q} ->"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+art(q)})
for i in range(120):
    ex=random.sample(V[:16],2)+random.sample(C[:20],2); random.shuffle(ex)
    q=random.choice(V+C)
    while q in ex: q=random.choice(V+C)
    p=''.join(f"{w} -> {w}\n" for w in ex)+f"{q} ->"
    control.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+q.split()[0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
